Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1140
Claimant:
Jill Wyatt
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
19 Jul 2024
Claimant's attorney confirmed representation today and asked that all contact go through their office. Received the
initial loss notice dsecribing a left turn collision at an intersection, with the claimant reporting neck pain after the
impact.
18 Aug 2024
Reviewed the photos submitted with the first report. They show the rear-quarter damage and the front-end damage
on the other vehicle in the places one would expect from the described impact, and the vehicle damage lines up with
the account given. The driver is named on the policy and the police report places the claimant in the vehicle at the
scene.
2 Nov 2024
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account matched what was told at first notice, with the same sequence
and the same description of the turn, and no new details came up. No independent witnesses have come forward, so
the photos and the police report are carrying most of the weight on the crash details.
24 Nov 2024
Pulled the vehicle history. No earlier damage to this vehicle is on record, and nothing indicates the damage predates
the coverage start. Also noted a minor neck strain treated years ago that healed fully and was not connected to the
current complaint, which I will need to clarify with the treating provider.
29 Nov 2024
Treatment records received. The care followed a usual course for this kind of soft tissue injury, with the frequency of
visits tapering as the patient's symptoms improved. The reported whiplash fits the kind and force of the impact.
4 Jan 2025
Summary: the injury, the damage, and the claimant's account are consistent with one another and with the ploice
report. Recommend moving to evaluation of the bodily injury claim under counsel's demand, pending receipt of the
prior treatment records.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
